criteria.text: SolidWorks part: a closed tag inside the box

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The part is drawn in the template, the outline is one closed shape inside the 2 in by 2 in box, there is at least one chain hole, it is extruded, and the tag stays in one piece with metal around every hole and cut-out.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The part is extruded and closed, but a hole or cut-out crosses the outline, leaves a sliver thin enough to snap, or the outline leaves the box.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The outline is not closed, there is no chain hole, or the sketch was never extruded.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No SolidWorks part was handed in, or it will not open.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The student's name and at least one more text or image element are on the tag in xTool Studio, and everything sits fully inside the outline, clear of the holes.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only a name is on the tag, or something added crosses or touches the outline or a hole.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing is added to the tag shape.

criteria.text: xTool file ready to run on the MetalFab

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The project is set to the MetalFab CNC Cutter, the DXF outline and every hole are set to Cut while the name and image are set to Engrave or Score, the tag fits inside 2.00 in by 2.00 in, and it cuts from center outward, so every hole cuts before the outline.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Machine, settings, size or order wrong
levels.descriptor: The project is set to a different machine, cuts and engraving are mixed up, the tag is larger than 2.00 in by 2.00 in, or the outline cuts before a hole.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No xTool Studio file was handed in.
